intro: Three lands meet here. You are in Tripolis on the Meander, an ancient city in Denizli province from the 2nd century BC, founded where Lydia, Caria and Phrygia meet. Recent excavation has brought its colonnaded street and great church back into the light.
history: The city was founded at the meeting point of Lydia, Caria and Phrygia, on the edge of the Meander plain, and its very name refers to that junction. In recent years the excavators have uncovered its colonnaded street, its theatre and a large early Christian church.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the colonnaded street and the theatre. Then visit the basilica, and walk out to the city walls.
facts: Did you know? The paved street has been uncovered along its full length, together with the shops that lined it, and that is a rare survival. The city was founded where Lydia, Caria and Phrygia meet, and its name refers to that triple border. Uncovering a colonnaded street whole, shops and all, is a rare thing indeed.
outro: This brings our tour of Tripolis on the Meander to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Let this street wait for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
